## Overview

STARmap PLUS (Zeng et al., Nat Neurosci 2023; SCP1375), control mice only: 8 and 13 months, 2 sections each (35,771 cells).

1. Plot the 4 sections coloured by cell type.
2. Build a Seurat object from `expression_matrix_raw.csv`, `metadata.csv` and the per-section coordinate files.
3. Subset to the hippocampus and save both objects.

```{r setup}
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(tibble)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(Matrix)
library(Seurat)

data_dir <- "STARmap_PLUS_data"

out_dir <- file.path("output", "07_STARmapPLUS_ControlSpatialObject")
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

## Spatial plot

### Load the 4 control coordinate files

```{r load-spatial}

spatial_files <- c(
  "8months-control-replicate_1"  = file.path(data_dir, "spatial_8months-control-replicate_1.csv"),
  "8months-control-replicate_2"  = file.path(data_dir, "spatial_8months-control-replicate_2.csv"),
  "13months-control-replicate_1" = file.path(data_dir, "spatial_13months-control-replicate_1.csv"),
  "13months-control-replicate_2" = file.path(data_dir, "spatial_13months-control-replicate_2.csv")
)

panel_order <- names(spatial_files)

read_scp_cluster_file <- function(path) {
  out <- read.csv(path, skip = 2, header = FALSE,
                   col.names = c("NAME", "X", "Y", "X_scaled", "Y_scaled",
                                 "label", "top_level_cell_type", "sub_level_cell_type"),
                   colClasses = c("character", "numeric", "numeric", "numeric", "numeric",
                                  "character", "character", "character"))
  stopifnot(is.numeric(out$X), is.numeric(out$Y)) 
  out
}

spatial_all <- map_dfr(spatial_files, read_scp_cluster_file) |>
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = panel_order))

spatial_all
```

### Cell-type palette

```{r palette}

cell_type_palette <- c(
  "Astro"  = "#1f77b4",
  "CA1"    = "#ff7f0e",
  "CA2"    = "#2ca02c",
  "CA3"    = "#d62728",
  "CTX-Ex" = "#9467bd",
  "DG"     = "#8c564b",
  "Endo"   = "#e377c2",
  "Inh"    = "#7f7f7f",
  "LHb"    = "#bcbd22",
  "Micro"  = "#17becf",
  "OPC"    = "#aec7e8",
  "Oligo"  = "#ffbb78",
  "SMC"    = "#98df8a"
)

spatial_all <- spatial_all |>
  mutate(top_level_cell_type = factor(top_level_cell_type, levels = names(cell_type_palette)))
```

### Plot

One panel per section, y axis flipped (image coordinates). Built as 4 separate plots combined with `patchwork`, because `facet_wrap(scales = "free")` can't be combined with `coord_fixed()`.

```{r spatial-plot}
#| fig-width: 11
#| fig-height: 10

panel_titles <- spatial_all |>
  count(label, name = "n_cells", .drop = FALSE) |>
  mutate(panel_title = sprintf("%s  (n=%s cells)", label, format(n_cells, big.mark = ","))) |>
  select(label, panel_title) |>
  deframe()

plot_one_sample <- function(lbl) {
  sub <- spatial_all |> filter(label == lbl)
  ggplot(sub, aes(x = X, y = Y, color = top_level_cell_type)) +
    geom_point(size = 1.1, alpha = 0.9, stroke = 0) +
    scale_color_manual(values = cell_type_palette, name = "Cell type", drop = FALSE) +
    scale_y_reverse() +
    coord_fixed() +
    guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3, alpha = 1))) +
    labs(title = panel_titles[[as.character(lbl)]]) +
    theme_void(base_size = 12) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 10, face = "bold"))
}

panel_plots <- map(panel_order, plot_one_sample)

wrap_plots(panel_plots, ncol = 2) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "STARmap PLUS -- control mice, spatial coordinates by cell type",
    theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 14))
  )
```

## Check the expression matrix before loading it


```{r inspect-matrix-raw-lines}

matrix_path <- file.path(data_dir, "expression_matrix_raw.csv")

raw_lines <- readLines(matrix_path, n = 2)
cat("Line 1, first 300 characters:\n")
cat(substr(raw_lines[1], 1, 300), "\n\n")
cat("Line 2, first 300 characters:\n")
cat(substr(raw_lines[2], 1, 300), "\n")
```

The matrix is genes x cells: first column `GENE`, then one column per cell named by an integer cell ID. 

```{r inspect-matrix-peek}
matrix_peek <- read.csv(matrix_path, header = TRUE, nrows = 5, check.names = FALSE)
n_cols <- ncol(matrix_peek)

cat("Number of columns:", n_cols, "\n")
cat("First column name (gene-ID column):", names(matrix_peek)[1], "\n")
cat("First 10 cell-ID column names:\n")
print(head(names(matrix_peek)[-1], 10))
cat("\nFirst 5 gene names (first data column, first 5 rows):\n")
print(matrix_peek[[1]])
```

```{r inspect-matrix-id-match}

# first data row is SCP's "TYPE" row -> drop it
metadata_all <- read.csv(file.path(data_dir, "metadata.csv"))
metadata_all <- metadata_all[metadata_all$NAME != "TYPE", ]
metadata_all$NAME <- as.integer(metadata_all$NAME)
metadata_all$orig_index <- as.integer(metadata_all$orig_index)

n_cells_total   <- nrow(metadata_all)
n_cells_control <- metadata_all |> filter(label %in% panel_order) |> nrow()
cat("Total cells in metadata.csv:", n_cells_total, "\n")
cat("Cells in the 4 control samples:", n_cells_control, "(expected 35,771)\n\n")

# matrix column names should all be metadata NAME values
matrix_col_ids <- names(matrix_peek)[-1]
name_hits      <- sum(matrix_col_ids %in% as.character(metadata_all$NAME))

cat("Matrix column IDs matching metadata$NAME:", name_hits, "/", length(matrix_col_ids), "\n")
```

Matrix column headers match metadata's `NAME` column (unique across all sections); `orig_index` restarts in each section and must not be used as a key. Columns are selected by position, which is only valid if the matrix columns are in the same order as the metadata rows -- checked here, and the render stops if they aren't.

```{r inspect-matrix-position-check}

matrix_ids_all <- names(matrix_peek)[-1]

same_length <- length(matrix_ids_all) == nrow(metadata_all)
same_order  <- if (same_length) identical(matrix_ids_all, as.character(metadata_all$NAME)) else FALSE

cat("Data columns in expression_matrix_raw.csv:", length(matrix_ids_all), "\n")
cat("Rows in metadata.csv:", nrow(metadata_all), "\n")
cat("Same length:", same_length, "\n")
cat("Column order matches metadata_all$NAME row-for-row:", same_order, "\n")

# columns are selected by position below -> must match metadata row order
stopifnot(same_order)
```

## Build the control-subset count matrix

```{r build-count-matrix}
# metadata rows of the 4 control sections; the same positions index the matrix columns (+1 for GENE)
control_row_positions <- which(metadata_all$label %in% panel_order)

# new unique cell IDs; remove_rownames() so column_to_rownames() works later
control_meta <- metadata_all[control_row_positions, ] |>
  tibble::remove_rownames() |>
  mutate(cell_id = paste0("Cell_", dplyr::row_number()))

stopifnot(nrow(control_meta) == 35771)          # sanity check against the known control cell count
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(control_meta$cell_id))  # must be unique by construction

expr_df <- read.csv(matrix_path, header = TRUE, check.names = FALSE)
gene_names <- expr_df[[1]]

expr_mat <- as.matrix(expr_df[, control_row_positions + 1])
rownames(expr_mat) <- gene_names
colnames(expr_mat) <- control_meta$cell_id

counts_sparse <- Matrix::Matrix(expr_mat, sparse = TRUE)
rm(expr_df, expr_mat); gc()

saveRDS(counts_sparse, file.path(out_dir, "starmap_plus_control_counts.rds"))

cat("Built control-subset count matrix:", nrow(counts_sparse), "genes x", ncol(counts_sparse), "cells\n")

```

## Assemble the Seurat object

Coordinates are stored as a 2-D `spatial` reduction (no Visium-style image slot), so `DimPlot(obj, reduction = "spatial")` works.

```{r build-seurat}

meta_for_seurat <- control_meta |>
  column_to_rownames("cell_id")

starmap_obj <- CreateSeuratObject(
  counts    = counts_sparse,
  meta.data = meta_for_seurat,
  project   = "STARmapPLUS_control"
)

# coordinate files only have NAME -> map to cell_id via the (label, NAME) key
name_to_cell_id <- control_meta |>
  transmute(join_key = paste(as.character(label), NAME, sep = "___"), cell_id)

coords_for_seurat <- spatial_all |>
  mutate(join_key = paste(as.character(label), NAME, sep = "___")) |>
  left_join(name_to_cell_id, by = "join_key") |>
  filter(!is.na(cell_id), cell_id %in% colnames(starmap_obj)) |>
  distinct(cell_id, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  arrange(match(cell_id, colnames(starmap_obj))) |>
  select(cell_id, X, Y)

cat("coords_for_seurat rows:", nrow(coords_for_seurat), " | ncol(starmap_obj):", ncol(starmap_obj), "\n")

cat("\ncontrol_meta rows per label:\n")
print(table(control_meta$label))
cat("\nspatial_all rows per label:\n")
print(table(spatial_all$label))

missing_cell_ids <- setdiff(colnames(starmap_obj), coords_for_seurat$cell_id)
cat("\nCells in starmap_obj with NO matched spatial coordinate:", length(missing_cell_ids), "\n")
if (length(missing_cell_ids) > 0) {
  missing_preview <- control_meta[control_meta$cell_id %in% head(missing_cell_ids, 10),
                                   c("cell_id", "label", "NAME")]
  cat("A sample of unmatched cells (check these NAME/label values against spatial_all by eye):\n")
  print(missing_preview)
}

stopifnot(nrow(coords_for_seurat) == ncol(starmap_obj))

spatial_emb <- as.matrix(coords_for_seurat |> select(X, Y))
rownames(spatial_emb) <- coords_for_seurat$cell_id
colnames(spatial_emb) <- c("spatial_1", "spatial_2")

starmap_obj[["spatial"]] <- CreateDimReducObject(
  embeddings = spatial_emb,
  key = "spatial_",
  assay = DefaultAssay(starmap_obj)
)

saveRDS(starmap_obj, file.path(out_dir, "starmap_plus_control_seurat.rds"))

starmap_obj

```

## Verify: re-plot from the Seurat object

Same plot as above, rebuilt only from `starmap_obj`. If counts, metadata and coordinates are aligned, it looks identical.

```{r verify-seurat-plot}
#| fig-width: 11
#| fig-height: 10

verify_coords <- as.data.frame(Embeddings(starmap_obj, "spatial"))
verify_coords$cell_id <- rownames(verify_coords)

verify_meta <- starmap_obj@meta.data
verify_meta$cell_id <- rownames(verify_meta)

verify_df <- verify_coords |>
  left_join(verify_meta |> select(cell_id, label, top_level_cell_type), by = "cell_id") |>
  mutate(
    label = factor(label, levels = panel_order),
    top_level_cell_type = factor(top_level_cell_type, levels = names(cell_type_palette))
  )

stopifnot(nrow(verify_df) == ncol(starmap_obj))  # every cell got a coordinate + cell type back

verify_panel_titles <- verify_df |>
  count(label, name = "n_cells", .drop = FALSE) |>
  mutate(panel_title = sprintf("%s  (n=%s cells)", label, format(n_cells, big.mark = ","))) |>
  select(label, panel_title) |>
  deframe()

plot_one_sample_verify <- function(lbl) {
  sub <- verify_df |> filter(label == lbl)
  ggplot(sub, aes(x = spatial_1, y = spatial_2, color = top_level_cell_type)) +
    geom_point(size = 1.1, alpha = 0.9, stroke = 0) +
    scale_color_manual(values = cell_type_palette, name = "Cell type", drop = FALSE) +
    scale_y_reverse() +
    coord_fixed() +
    guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3, alpha = 1))) +
    labs(title = verify_panel_titles[[as.character(lbl)]]) +
    theme_void(base_size = 12) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 10, face = "bold"))
}

verify_plots <- map(panel_order, plot_one_sample_verify)

wrap_plots(verify_plots, ncol = 2) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Verification -- same plot, rebuilt entirely from starmap_obj",
    theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 14))
  )

```

## Restrict to hippocampus

`metadata.csv`'s `region` column is used directly.

```{r region-breakdown}

cat("Cells per region (all 4 samples combined):\n")
print(table(starmap_obj$region))
cat("\nCells per region_merged:\n")
print(table(starmap_obj$region_merged))
cat("\nCells per region x sample:\n")
print(table(starmap_obj$region, starmap_obj$label))
```

Subset to `region == "Hippocampus"`; the full object is saved separately.

```{r subset-hippocampus}

starmap_hpc <- subset(starmap_obj, subset = region == "Hippocampus")

cat("Hippocampus-only:", ncol(starmap_hpc), "cells (from", ncol(starmap_obj), "total)\n")
cat("\nPer-sample counts, hippocampus only:\n")
print(table(starmap_hpc$label))

saveRDS(starmap_hpc, file.path(out_dir, "starmap_plus_control_seurat_hippocampus.rds"))
```

```{r hippocampus-plot}
#| fig-width: 11
#| fig-height: 10

hpc_coords <- as.data.frame(Embeddings(starmap_hpc, "spatial"))
hpc_coords$cell_id <- rownames(hpc_coords)

hpc_meta <- starmap_hpc@meta.data
hpc_meta$cell_id <- rownames(hpc_meta)

hpc_df <- hpc_coords |>
  left_join(hpc_meta |> select(cell_id, label, top_level_cell_type), by = "cell_id") |>
  mutate(
    label = factor(label, levels = panel_order),
    top_level_cell_type = factor(top_level_cell_type, levels = names(cell_type_palette))
  )

hpc_panel_titles <- hpc_df |>
  count(label, name = "n_cells", .drop = FALSE) |>
  mutate(panel_title = sprintf("%s  (n=%s cells)", label, format(n_cells, big.mark = ","))) |>
  select(label, panel_title) |>
  deframe()

plot_one_sample_hpc <- function(lbl) {
  sub <- hpc_df |> filter(label == lbl)
  ggplot(sub, aes(x = spatial_1, y = spatial_2, color = top_level_cell_type)) +
    geom_point(size = 1.1, alpha = 0.9, stroke = 0) +
    scale_color_manual(values = cell_type_palette, name = "Cell type", drop = FALSE) +
    scale_y_reverse() +
    coord_fixed() +
    guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3, alpha = 1))) +
    labs(title = hpc_panel_titles[[as.character(lbl)]]) +
    theme_void(base_size = 12) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 10, face = "bold"))
}

hpc_plots <- map(panel_order, plot_one_sample_hpc)

wrap_plots(hpc_plots, ncol = 2) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "STARmap PLUS -- hippocampus only, control mice",
    theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 14))
  )

```

## Highlight selected cell types

```{r highlight-celltype}
#| fig-width: 11
#| fig-height: 10

highlight_types <- c("Micro", "OPC", "Astro", "Endo") 

stopifnot(all(highlight_types %in% names(cell_type_palette)))

hl_coords <- as.data.frame(Embeddings(starmap_hpc, "spatial"))
hl_coords$cell_id <- rownames(hl_coords)

hl_meta <- starmap_hpc@meta.data
hl_meta$cell_id <- rownames(hl_meta)

hl_df <- hl_coords |>
  left_join(hl_meta |> select(cell_id, label, top_level_cell_type), by = "cell_id") |>
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = panel_order))

hl_panel_titles <- hl_df |>
  count(label, name = "n_cells", .drop = FALSE) |>
  mutate(panel_title = sprintf("%s  (n=%s cells)", label, format(n_cells, big.mark = ","))) |>
  select(label, panel_title) |>
  deframe()

plot_one_sample_highlight <- function(lbl) {
  sub        <- hl_df |> filter(label == lbl)
  background <- sub |> filter(!top_level_cell_type %in% highlight_types)
  foreground <- sub |>
    filter(top_level_cell_type %in% highlight_types) |>
    mutate(top_level_cell_type = factor(top_level_cell_type, levels = highlight_types))

  per_type_n <- foreground |> count(top_level_cell_type, name = "n", .drop = FALSE)
  subtitle_txt <- paste(sprintf("%s: n=%s", per_type_n$top_level_cell_type, format(per_type_n$n, big.mark = ",")),
                         collapse = "   ")

  ggplot() +
    geom_point(data = background, aes(x = spatial_1, y = spatial_2),
               color = "grey85", size = 1.1, alpha = 0.6, stroke = 0) +
    geom_point(data = foreground, aes(x = spatial_1, y = spatial_2, color = top_level_cell_type),
               size = 1.3, alpha = 0.95, stroke = 0) +
    scale_color_manual(values = cell_type_palette[highlight_types], name = "Cell type", drop = FALSE) +
    scale_y_reverse() +
    coord_fixed() +
    guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3, alpha = 1))) +
    labs(title = hl_panel_titles[[as.character(lbl)]], subtitle = subtitle_txt) +
    theme_void(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 10, face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 8)
    )
}

highlight_plots <- map(panel_order, plot_one_sample_highlight)

wrap_plots(highlight_plots, ncol = 2) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(
    title = paste("STARmap PLUS, hippocampus only -- highlighting", paste(highlight_types, collapse = ", ")),
    theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 14))
  )

```

## Notes

- Cell IDs are new sequential `Cell_1 … Cell_n`; original `NAME`, `orig_index` and `label` are kept as metadata.
- `starmap_hpc` contains `region == "Hippocampus"` only.
- Saved: `starmap_plus_control_seurat.rds` (all regions) and `starmap_plus_control_seurat_hippocampus.rds`.
